execute.description: point notifications about bug tasks at their bug
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."notification" AS n SET "targetType" = 'bug', "targetId" = b."id" FROM "public"."bug_report" AS b WHERE n."targetType" IS NULL AND n."taskId" = b."taskId"

execute.description: point the remaining task notifications at their task
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."notification" SET "targetType" = 'task', "targetId" = "taskId" WHERE "targetType" IS NULL AND "taskId" IS NOT NULL

execute.description: point approval request notifications at their request
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."notification" AS n SET "targetType" = 'approval', "targetId" = r."id" FROM "public"."approval_request" AS r, "public"."user" AS u WHERE n."targetType" IS NULL AND n."taskId" IS NULL AND n."type" = 'status' AND n."projectId" = r."projectId" AND n."createdAt" = r."requestedAt" AND n."actorId" = r."requestedById" AND u."id" = n."userId" AND u."clientCompanyId" = r."companyId" AND n."text" = CASE WHEN r."version" > 1 THEN 'Approval requested again: ' ELSE 'Approval requested: ' END || r."subjectTitle"

postcheck.description: verify no task notification was left without a target
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."notification" WHERE "taskId" IS NOT NULL AND "targetType" IS NULL) AS "result"
